topic.title: Rail Infrastructure / Level Crossings / Transport and Works Act
topic.source_contract: rail asset boundary, operational railway, level crossing type and risk, traffic change, asset protection, Transport and Works Act or Planning Act powers, land rights, construction possession, commissioning and safety acceptance evidence

scope_guards: A rail proposal is not treated as an authorised railway.
A level-crossing risk assessment is not treated as an approved order.
A planning consultation response is not treated as asset-protection agreement.
A Transport and Works Act application is not treated as a made order.
A made order is not treated as completed works.
A possession booking is not treated as commissioned infrastructure.
A crossing closure proposal is not treated as a legally stopped-up right of way.
No score or promotion is written without exact powers, agreements, land rights, works, testing and safety acceptance.
